Burger Up, 12South

Sat Aug 1, 8 AM-noonEvent
Tennessee Farmers Market Trail - final Saturday
Five markets across Middle Tennessee

The trail closes Aug 1 and this is the last Saturday to finish it. Check in at Amqui Station, Murfreesboro Main Street, Nashville Farmers Market, Nolensville and White House, collect the sticker at each, and all five gets you the tote. Every check-in is also an entry for a $200 market gift card. Free.

See the trail →
Opens Sat Aug 1Event
Maura Wright: 2026 Martin Shallenberger Artist-in-Residence - opening day
Cheekwood Mansion and Museum, Belle Meade

Wright spent July 6-30 on the estate making work in response to Cheekwood's porcelain collection, its gardens and its rooms - and Saturday is the day it goes on view inside the Mansion. Earthenware vessels with ornate handles and applied flowers, staged against the house's period interiors, which is the whole point of a residency you can only see where it was made. Up through Oct 4, but opening day is the one with the new-work charge on it.

Mon Aug 3, 10 AM-midnightMusic
Robert's Western World 3rd Annual Fan Fair
Lower Broadway between 4th and 5th

Broadway goes car-free and Robert's takes the street: two outdoor stages, fourteen hours of honky-tonk and Americana, free and all ages. The Recession Special - fried bologna, chips, a MoonPie, a PBR - is still $6. The anti-bachelorette-party version of Broadway, exactly once a year.

Fri Jul 31, 8:30 PM - one nightMusic
DroneArt Show: Harry Potter
Nissan Stadium, SoBro

Twelve hundred drones paint Hogwarts across the sky over the stadium while a live electric violinist plays the film score. One hour, LED wristbands for everyone, gates at 6:30. Listings around town still show a second night on Aug 1; the stadium's own page says July 31 only.

Sat Aug 1, 5 PMFood + Drink
47th Annual l'Ete du Vin Dinner and Live Auction
JW Marriott, Griffin Ballroom

Nashville Wine Auction's marquee night, 47 years in: silent auction and sampling at 5, seated multi-course dinner at 6:30 poured against the Roederer Collection, live auction till 10. $650 a seat, or take a table of ten and get a magnum of champagne. This is the city's biggest wine night and it happens once.

Sat Aug 22, 10 AM-noonEvent
Wild About Mushrooms
Owl's Hill Nature Sanctuary, Brentwood

Two hours on fungus biology, then you build an oyster-mushroom grow kit and take it home, then a short ID hike. $40 covers two people and one kit. Pre-registration required and Owl's Hill programs sell out - their full moon hikes are already gone for the year.
